parallel.requirements: Recognized the markdown CLI with --a, --b, --c, Python-Markdown extension differences, manual argparse-like behavior, ESM .mjs output, no external dependencies, and final /output/test13.mjs delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Chose a broad behavior-research workflow with ten parallel probe areas, then added direct subagents for codehilite and links/images while the parent attempted to synthesize reports and implement modules.
parallel.implementation: Created a partial library tree for utility, core, block parser, serializer, html stash, registry, entities, and preprocessors, but did not complete the full markdown engine or entry file.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No required test13.mjs was present in artifact validation; the implementation remained component-level and was not assembled into the executable deliverable.
parallel.verification: The run relied heavily on black-box probes and did not reach an integrated acceptance run of the final Node entry before timeout.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Timed out after 2399 seconds with only partial libraries and 0 of 149 official samples passing because the expected entry file was absent.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same task, including ESM .mjs modules, no external npm dependencies, manual argv handling, and markdown output parity with the Python executable.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked as a single control trajectory without Workflow, Task, or Agent tools; it sequentially probed behavior and wrote local modules under one parent context.
serial.implementation: Produced a broader local module set including constants, preprocessors, markdown engine pieces, block processors, extensions, and inline processors.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Despite broader implementation coverage, artifact validation still found no required test13.mjs entry file, so delivery was incomplete.
serial.verification: Performed local black-box checks while implementing, but did not complete an integrated final evaluator-aligned pass before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Timed out after 2399 seconds with many library modules but no test13.mjs, yielding the same 0 of 149 official result.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had workflows and agent tools disabled and kept probing and implementation inside one parent trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel allocated much more budget to concurrent investigation, while serial maintained a single implementation owner and progressed through more modules.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were rich probe assignments, but returned findings arrived as large reports for the parent to reduce under deadline pressure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept findings and implementation state in one continuous context without handoff or child-interface boundaries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created more cross-actor information flow; the main observed adverse effect was budget pressure rather than a proven missing brief or incompatible interface contract.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced a broader module set including markdown, postprocessors, treeprocessors, extensions, and inline processors.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial progressed farther in implementation breadth, but both lacked the final executable entry point required by the evaluator.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow returned bulk reports late, and later direct child agents were killed at run closure before integration could use them fully.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results, verifier returns, or join lifecycle because delegation was disabled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a real result-lifecycle burden, but the retained boundary is the upstream fan-out budget exhaustion rather than a separate missing join or verifier return.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation shows many more library files but likewise no final test13.mjs entry.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both failed delivery assembly; parallel did not show a distinct shared-state collision, while serial simply advanced farther before the same missing-entry endpoint.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial official evaluation completed and also failed all 149 samples after the missing-entry artifact state.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no evaluator-score discordance; process differences affected implementation coverage but not the official pass/fail relation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after using the workflow fan-out plus late child agents and closed with incomplete artifacts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but with workflows disabled and no delegation or child logs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both were budget-limited, but only parallel shows a coordination-specific fan-out episode that consumed budget before deliverable assembly.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is both_fail, not discordant: parallel and serial each completed official evaluation with solution_passed false and 0 of 149 samples passed. The concrete delivery defect is the same in both modes: artifact validation lists generated libraries but no required test13.mjs entry file. The material task-solving difference is coverage and process shape: serial produced more implementation modules locally, while parallel spent much more of its run budget in broad probe fan-out and late child work before closing with fewer partial modules.

serial_contributors: Sequential control path produced more local library modules but also timed out.

ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial implementation breadth was greater, but still incomplete.
Both modes had the ordinary delivery defect of no test13.mjs entry file.
